scope: Independent static technical source/method/test-design review; not manuscript acceptance, numerical qualification or execution release.
disposition: No confirmed mathematical/masking/scoring source blocker for the intended separately scoped one representative TRAIN-only runtime check. Full paired family adoption remains blocked byF01, writable output configuration and unmeasured actual budget.

train_only_runtime_check.intended_next_operation: One representative native/F4/auxiliary TRAIN-only runtime check before full paired family release; actual budgets remain unmeasured.
train_only_runtime_check.separate_scoped_invocation_required: Supplied main is a full-family driver behind runtime/full-budget gates and does not implement a limited check.

findings.title: Missing paired receipt evidence can be accepted as equal
findings.finding: COMMON and AUXILIARY_COMMON are compared with row.get. Except for initial state on the first target-only row, mandatory presence/type is not checked. An epoch negative hash omitted in all three streams or auxiliary fields omitted in both joint/separate streams compare equal as None, allowing paired_eligible=true without the required evidence.
findings.resolution: A prospective successor should enforce mandatory field presence/types/nonempty hashes and first-batch negative hashes in every epoch before paired eligibility. Preserve this immutable source.

findings.title: Default output resolves into the sealed source
findings.finding: Relative output resolves under the packet, whose observed mode is0555. Ordinary unprivileged execution cannot create the default run directory there. An external config location does not move that default.
findings.resolution: Supply an absolute writable output path outside immutable source in any execution config/command; this can be satisfied without changing implementation source.

findings.title: Checkpoint chunks retain all gathered scorer inputs
findings.finding: Each head checkpoint receives two advanced-indexed [chunk,512] inputs retained until backward. For four float32 heads and total support L this alone is2*4*L*512*4 bytes. The metadata bound L<=64*(4267-2)=272960 gives at most4472176640 bytes, about4.17GiB, excluding native target activations, graph states, ESP history and allocator overhead. Actual L/r/time/peaks remain unmeasured; graph rebuild, receipt hashing and synchronizations belong in the representative cost.
findings.resolution: Measure the current complete full-size update, backward and receipts in the intended one representative TRAIN-only check. Do not infer a family budget from the bound or earlier Collab/census results.

static_assessments.tensor_scoring: F4 h is [4,N,512]; auxiliary eta is [4,slots]. Left scores(v,w), right scores(u,w) using inherited raw Hadamard MLPs. Checkpoint head defaults bind each member. Shared graph powers propagate the constant affine-bias channel. No auxiliary Parameter/module or serving override is added.
static_assessments.mask_leakage: Full undirected Boolean TRAIN membership is checked against the complete native unweighted graph. Whole batch positive and selected query identities are removed in both directions and deduplicated. Both endpoints and visible common neighbors are excluded from residual supports, which remain query-grouped and node-sorted. Detached complete-TRAIN teacher bits label the opposite incidence; neither bits/counts nor hidden incidence enter masked graph/scorer context. Learned TRAIN embeddings and the target path remain intentional transductive reconstruction context, not proof of unseen-link independence.
static_assessments.stratified_objective: Owned randperm samples up to32 positions without replacement from B positives and3B already-drawn negatives. Under the pinned sampler selected positives are already masked and selected negatives are absent from complete TRAIN, so selected-query removal leaves the mask fixed. Half each sample mean estimates the declared equal-stratum objective conditional on minibatch/negative pool, with scorer dropout understood in expectation. It is not a full-graph likelihood or equal weighting of all4B origins. A future sampler admitting TRAIN incidences would change the mask and invalidate this fixed-mask argument.
static_assessments.loss_scale: Nominal WeightedHingeAUC plus margin=None reaches native auc_loss: the literal3B squared-margin sum, averaged over4 members. Adding3B*lambda*A gives L/(3B)=member-mean squared margin+lambda*A, including actual tailB. Lambda1 is a fixed adaptation, not measured gradient balance or optimum. Embeddings remain outside inherited encoder/predictor clipping groups.
static_assessments.exact_law: The exact core is byte-identical. Reachable ESP recurrence, complementing, common-logit centering, zero-weight padding, deterministic connected-zero sides and total-support denominator are coherent in static inspection. Only the chosen joint/separate key is optimized. Float32 finite gradients and dense-DDI backward are unverified.
static_assessments.paired_rng: Fresh constructor/parameterization/initialization and seed resets match across arms. Target runs first, z is reused, scorer seed is owned/forked and checkpoint forward RNG is preserved during recomputation. CPU/current-GPU RNG is checked after auxiliary forward and backward. Joint/separate share logits/context/selection and differ only in loss key. Executed RNG preservation and CUDA determinism remain unverified; receipt completeness needsF01.
static_assessments.serving_checkpoint_VALID: Inherited serving is complete-TRAIN uniform raw route-score mean. Fixed native VALID pools and OGB Hits@20/50/100 are retained, with no TEST path. The unchanged500-epoch driver checks every5 epochs, selects strict improvement with first exact ties, saves own encoder/predictor/embedding state and performs one complete selected-state replay. There are100 scheduled VALID traversals+1 replay per cell.
static_assessments.collapse_degree_confounds: Same-logit joint/separate side marginals and log-space overlap identity are correct; deterministic sides erase coupling and collapsed laws are allowed. Independently initialized heads do not guarantee diversity. Common-offset cancellation does not remove candidate-specific degree effects. Uniform/visible-degree probes use matched supports/labels/denominator. Shared TRAIN embeddings, overlapping contexts, wedge/triangle structure and whole-batch mask allocation remain confounds. End-fit joint/separate includes optimization and changed marginals; target-only comparisons also include augmentation/compute. The protocol appropriately limits these interpretations.
static_assessments.cost: Metadata gives4267 nodes,1067911 TRAIN records,17 updates/epoch with19335 tail; nine500-epoch cells imply76500 native updates and51000 added masked15-hop passes, with at most3264000 selected queries. Exact ESP autograd history scales withM*n*min(k,n-k), beyond checkpoint inputs and two live encoder paths. No DDI measured time/memory or full-family budget is available.
